context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is complete and verified. Constants: _REPO_ACCESS_RETRY_BUDGET_MS=90_000, _REPO_ACCESS_RETRY_DELAY_MS=4000. Vitest suites at NewUserWizard.repoAccessRetry.test.jsx (5 tests) and NewUserWizard.connectRefinement.test.jsx (3 tests) all pass. /login route renders normally from external browser automation.
rca of the issue: Old code retried only 3× at 3s (9s budget), while GitHub App install permission propagation lag is documented in this codebase to exceed 60s. Production log for canndalf showed app_install_granted firing exactly 3 times before repo_connect_gate_skipped — matching the old _REPO_ACCESS_MAX_RETRIES=3 constant exactly. Fix replaces attempt-count with a 90s time budget at 4s intervals, keeping the user on a calm 'Almost there...' UI throughout, only surfacing the real error after the full 90s ceiling is exceeded.
